name: Herdr (terminal agents)
provides: See your terminal agents in Herdr and drive them: which ones are working, stuck or done, and getting them moving

install.system: Install Herdr from https://herdr.dev, then open Herdr once, in your own terminal

asks: looking at your terminal agents: it asks once, and a standing answer covers later looks
every drive of a terminal agent: sending it text, keys or a prompt, naming the pane or agent
note: Only the CTO role holds this. Listing and reading panes and agents asks once; driving one asks every time, naming the pane or agent and the command.
migrationDebt: Raw tool installation/execution and third-party SDK ownership must move to published BYOKit capabilities; this manifest records current behavior, not an approved bypass.
